answers.how: A hypothesis, measured by the proof: add `PROOF_TIMEOUT_S = 300` at the top level of cairn/devices/tester/proofs/test_seal_is_never_silently_dropped.py. Budget = measured wall plus margin: the slowest idle wall is 53 s (Windows), so 300 s is 5.7x it and 12.5x the Linux idle; it is 2.5x the 120 s that sweep load already exceeded, so it covers the sweep at up to ~2.5x slowdown beyond the point it timed out. It stays under the proof's own bounded waits summed (240 s + 180 s), so a real hang still reds inside the proof rather than at the budget. If the sweep measures above 300 s the number is re-measured, not guessed up.
